en: A black-and-white historical postcard showing a large military parade of infantry soldiers marching along a cobblestone street lined with dense crowds. The background is a grand classical building with arched ground-floor windows and circular dormer windows on the roof, heavily decorated and filled with spectators at the windows and on the roof. Flags hang from poles and the building, and the scene is clearly celebratory. Printed French text at the top describes the solemn entry of Marshal Pétain on 25 November 1918 and the infantry parade at Place Kléber in Strasbourg. There is also a small publisher's credit at the bottom.
